forbidden: You are not allowed to manage remote support settings.
action.resume: Open the running remote support session
dialog.title: Remote support
dialog.description: View the customer's screen with their consent; control needs a separate consent.
dialog.intro: The customer opens the ClickFix Support app and enters the code. Each step asks for a separate consent and they can stop at any time.
dialog.audit_note: Every step (creation, consents, control withdrawal, end) is written to the audit log.
mode.label: Mode
mode.view_hint: You see the screen but cannot use the mouse or keyboard.
mode.control_hint: If the customer also approves, you can use the mouse and keyboard.
mode.control_forbidden: You lack the control permission or the organization does not allow control.
preview.title: Message to the customer
preview.body:
For remote support, download the ClickFix Support app.
Open it and enter this code: {{code}}
The code is valid for 15 minutes and can be used once. You will be asked to approve before your screen is shared.
ClickFix and businesses will never ask you for a money transfer, bank login or card details.
preview.hint: The message goes out in the organization's language with the download link, through the conversation's channel. If the channel window is closed it is not sent and you pass the code on yourself.
code.title: Customer code
code.message_posted: The code and download link were sent to the customer as a message.
code.message_not_posted: The message could not be sent (channel window closed). Pass the code on to the customer yourself.
code.once_hint: The code and link are shown only now; they do not appear again once you close this window.
code.hidden: Waiting for the customer to enter the code. For security the code is not shown again; cancel and start a new session if needed.
steps.title: Session status
viewer.control_locked: Control locked: the customer withdrew control or a permission changed.
viewer.waiting_screen: Waiting for the customer to share their screen…
viewer.view_hint: You are only viewing. Use Tab to reach the tools.
viewer.keyboard_hint: Mouse and keyboard go to the customer. Press Esc twice quickly to get the keyboard back. System shortcuts (such as Ctrl+Alt+Del) are never sent.
summary.title: Session summary
summary.timeline_note: The summary was also added to the conversation timeline.
errors.REMOTE_SUPPORT_DISABLED: Remote support is turned off for this organization. An admin can turn it on in settings.
errors.REMOTE_SUPPORT_SUSPENDED: Remote support is suspended by the platform.
errors.REMOTE_SUPPORT_NOT_CONFIGURED: The media server is not configured.
errors.REMOTE_SUPPORT_CONFLICT: This conversation already has an open session or is closed.
errors.REMOTE_SUPPORT_CONSENT_REQUIRED: The customer has not approved viewing yet.
errors.REMOTE_SUPPORT_MINUTES_EXHAUSTED: This month's remote support minutes are used up.
errors.REMOTE_SUPPORT_CODE_INVALID: The code is invalid or has expired.
errors.ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED: Your plan does not include remote support.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again later.
settings.title: Remote support
settings.description: Agents view the customer's screen from a conversation and, with consent, control it.
settings.enabled_hint: Off by default because of the scam risk.
settings.allow_control_hint: When off, agents can only view. When on, the customer's separate consent and the agent's control permission are still required.
settings.max_duration_hint: Between 5 and 240 minutes. The session ends by itself when it runs out.
settings.recording_hint: Recording is a separate consent; if the customer says no the session continues unrecorded.
settings.retention_hint: Between 1 and 365 days. Expired recordings are deleted automatically.
settings.ready: Remote support is ready to use.
settings.not_configured: The media server (LiveKit) is not configured; sessions cannot start.
settings.not_entitled: Your plan does not include remote support.
settings.upgrade_hint: Remote support is part of higher plans.
settings.off_hint: Remote support is off; agents cannot start sessions.
settings.platform_disabled: The platform administrator turned remote support off. Reason: {{reason}}
settings.platform_suspended: Suspended after several scam reports in a short time. Reason: {{reason}}
platform.title: Remote support
platform.description: Turn off an organization's remote support (kill switch) and review reported sessions.
platform.disable_hint: All open sessions end at once. A reason is required and is shown on the organization's settings page.
platform.enable_hint: Lifts the kill switch or the automatic suspension.
dev.banner: Local development only: stands in for the ClickFix Support app until CF-239. Incoming control events are only listed, never applied.
dev.title: Development customer
dev.consent_view: I explicitly consent to my screen being viewed.
dev.consent_control: I allow the agent to use my mouse and keyboard.
dev.consent_recording: I allow the session to be recorded.
